correctness.rationale: PASS: Duplicating a leaf transfers failures from S_m to S_{m+1}. The explicit disjunction Phi_m=∨_{i=0}^m Box(|2m x−2i|−1) is valid at all worlds of S_m because m+1 pairwise-disjoint interval tests cannot each contain an m-leaf value. On S_{m+1}, assigning x(v_i)=i/m yields Phi_m(root)=−1. For any formula with at most m Box occurrences, select one min-attaining leaf for each outermost root-evaluated Box; all deeper modal formulas at terminal leaves are 0, so shrinking/padding the star to m leaves preserves its value. This proves the sharp lower bound, including nested modalities and failures at leaves. Independent exact-rational counters checked m=1..8 and sampled valid-star valuations up to 10,000 per m.
